Every value carries its source and the source's publication date (EDGAR acceptance time; at or after the 16:00 ET close it counts from the next trading day). Generated by retro/generators/trgp/gen_trgp.py from the filings' converted rows: each figure is read from its labelled row, the row is asserted present in its own filing, and every rate, margin, tax rate and rule-T value is computed. Targa Resources Partners LP (NYSE: NGLS), which TRC consolidates, is a separate listed partnership: its unit prices and per-unit figures are never used.

listing.note: FY2010 10-K, Item 5: 'Our common stock has been listed on the New York Stock Exchange since December 7, 2010 under the symbol “TRGP.”' The IPO prospectus (424B1 of 2010-12-07): 'No public market currently exists for our common stock.' The FY2010 10-K's cover: 'As of June 30, 2010, the last day of the registrant’s most recently completed second quarter, the registrant’s common stock was not publicly traded.' The P/E exists only from the first trading day (the listing rule of method r2); Yahoo's TRGP series starts on 2010-12-07 and records no split or distribution
listing.partnership: 'Targa Resources Partners LP (NYSE: NGLS), a publicly traded Delaware limited partnership' (the IPO prospectus): a different security, not substituted
listing.eps_note: 'For 2008 and 2009, there was no net income available to common shareholders as the preferred shareholders are entitled to all undistributed earnings. As such, there were no earnings per share to our common shareholders during 2008 and 2009.' 'During 2010, in connection with the closing of the IPO, 6,409,697 shares of Series B Convertible Participating Preferred Stock, plus accreted value, were converted into 35,356,698 shares of common stock.' (FY2010 10-K)
